Schedule 8.1 adds reported MPTF voluntary contributions by recipient fund, without a contributor breakdown. Named-row reconciliation covers the individually coded funds.
meta.mapping_note: Entity destinations are reconstructed organizational assignments for the fund, not proof that a donor financed a particular expense.
